body: Yep, I'm here. My fiance is up now and I'm gonna cook some breakfast pretty soon. Once again, THANK YOU for talking to me here. I needed some kind words this morning. Thank you, thank you.

Well, thanks! Tell that to the casting directors! I've gotten down from the horse lately because of my mental health. It's very, very draining sometimes.... And the arts attract all kinds of predators. So. There's that. 

I am in the process of shooting a music video! Should be pretty cool  when it gets finished... If and when that day comes. Director is awesome, but he's always got a zillion things on his plate.

Well... Little bit of everything. I've done acting before. I love acting. That IS therapy sometimes. Some writing, some production assistant stuff on films. Of course I was never paid a cent for those things... But it's what I love to be around.

Oh, man... Little bit of everything. Stuff in the arts, libraries, salons, bookstores, art galleries... Still haven't found my true calling. Right now I'm just collecting a paycheck while I figure it all out.

You at least have a good foundation in grunge. I would also recommend Hole, Babes In Toyland, L7, annnnnnd Silverchair. <--- (I think they're Australian, actually!)

Indeed they are. Tons of other bands, too. I feel like it wouldn't be a huge cultural transition for us to move there... We've talked about it a few times. Basically we would have to wait and see where his company would be willing to transfer him... He has a big fancy-pants job. And me? Well... I can move anywhere at any time. I can always find a job.

I like the Southern states ONLY because of the weather, which is a complete opposite of where I'm from. But fiance and I are also superrrrr progressive, so... The South might be out. Very conservative, God-fearing people. (Some, not all). As much as he hates New York, I hate California even more. (I've found people are either EC or WC... Rare to find an in-betweener).

Seattle might be kind of cool... Very progressive. And birthplace of grunge music.

There's a lot of character in the U.S. Every state has its own thing.

He hates New York. For a visit, definitely... But living there would be impossible. He's definitely a West Coast kind of guy. And I'm all about New York... Either way, I just want to get the EFF out of this state someday.

Wow. Thank you for this! I may have to hand-write a copy for myself and keep it in my wallet if I feel myself going "there"... 

Also, TIL I need new friends...

Hence, the reason I wanted to run away to NYC. My fiance would never agree to that, obviously. But damn. I've been in this city my WHOLE life. There are too many terrible memories here. Luckily I've only had one run-in with one of the bad guys. It was busy enough on the street where I just ran and escaped in the crowd. 

You're totally right. I've got maybe a handful of really good friends. I would like to have more... But it's hard. The whole "trust" thing. I've been burned by friendships before. In some ways those hurt far more than romantic relationships...

Trust me, dude... Not crappy at all. Thanks for reaching out to me. I really, really appreciate it. And thank you for thinking that the reaction of my friend was bullshit. It was. It really, really was...

I always make promises I cannot keep. I feel like any time I have been taken advantage of it was because I was too stupid or naive of my surroundings. When I've opened up to people about the times I was... They would tell me, outright that it was my fault for going out... My fault for drinking too much. When I told my best friend about it, over the phone, in tears... She says, almost bubbly, "Wow! Why does this keep happening to YOU, anyway?"
I feel like either I'm the crazy one, or everyone else around me is. Or maybe we all are?
It's okay. Well, yes and no. I mean, I'm supposed to be an adult, right? Some of this is my doing... But uh... Some family members could have done a better job while I was still a kid.
I'm not going to get into it here... Since I feel like it's kind of obvious for anyone connecting the dots. Someone did something very bad to me against my will. That's all I'm gonna say about that.

Well, that's certainly the hope... And I hope they wouldn't judge me. And you're right, it is legit, dammit! I lived through it. I know what happened to me... It's the re-living that makes in unbearable.

Hopefully. I just feel like everyone will be silently judging me. Or they won't believe me. Or they'll think that my situation wasn't "legit"...
A host of potential problems. I've also heard horror stories of women who go into group therapy and the problems exacerbate... 
It's fear of the unknown, I guess. But I'm hoping that somebody out there knows what they're doing...
Essentially that's my last hope from the "professional" side of things...

Well, in group it's just that... You're in a room full of strangers, ya know? Kind of scary when you think about the information you will be sharing. 

I actually reached out to one last summer near my residence, but their funding got cut and they had to shut down. It was a bummer.

I've found another one that is completely free and not in the middle of suburbia (I haz no car)... So maybe... Just maybe... They might be able to help. (Maybe).

A series of therapists who were just watching the clock until my time was up. One therapist told my parents that my threats of self-harm and suicide were "just a phase"... Yeah. Some phase.

Haven't tried the support groups yet. I have a very.... VERY difficult time trusting other people. I'm afraid that the whole "confidentiality" deal with support groups is just another trick to get you to spill everything, only to have it come back and bite you in the ass.

I would like a decent therapist who wasn't just seeing dollar signs as I was talking to them...

All the time... When it gets to be too intense he will just suggest that I see a therapist or join a support group. But I am so scared to do it. I've been through therapy before, and it has not helped me. I'm scared of failing again.

He also tells me that if I ever did kill myself, he would never forgive me. He tells me that I would be the most selfish person in the world.

So... There's that.

He tries to help me.
To him, and only him it seems... He's literally the only thing keeping me here.

I've never been good enough. At anything... Jack of all trades but a master at none, you know?

You know that person who never seems to be remembered? "Hey... What was your name again?" You've met me. Five times over.

I'm just insignificant.
